15. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

Informal Negotiations

Before starting any legal action, you and CloudRift agree to first attempt to resolve any dispute through informal negotiation. To start negotiations, one Party must send written notice to the other Party. Both Parties agree to negotiate in good faith for at least thirty (30) days before moving forward with arbitration or litigation.

Binding Arbitration

If we are unable to resolve a dispute through informal negotiations, the dispute will be resolved exclusively through binding arbitration. Arbitration will be conducted by the American Arbitration Association (AAA) under its Commercial Arbitration Rules. The arbitration may be conducted remotely, in writing, by phone, or in person in California. Each Party will bear its own costs unless the arbitrator determines otherwise. Arbitration decisions are final and binding.

No Class Actions

Disputes must be brought individually. You and CloudRift agree that no arbitration will be joined with another proceeding, and there will be no class action, mass action, or private attorney general claims.

Exceptions

The following disputes are not subject to informal negotiations or arbitration and may be brought directly in court:

  • Disputes concerning intellectual property rights.
  • Allegations of unauthorized use, theft, piracy, or invasion of privacy.
  • Requests for injunctive relief.

Governing Law and Venue

If a dispute must be resolved in court (instead of arbitration), the dispute will be handled in the state or federal courts located in California. Both Parties consent to the personal jurisdiction of those courts.

Time Limit

Any dispute must be filed within one (1) year after the cause of action arises. Otherwise, the claim is permanently barred.
